text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT 3056789123 — high-rate outbound auth requests from svc-ingest-prod in prod-east-1. Probable token replay. Auto-escalate to oncall SRE. https://redwood.incidents/3056789123

samir (SRE): oncall here. seeing the page, joining. can someone paste first sample log?

maya (sec): grabbing logs now from auth-proxy and edge. running quick query against prod ELK.
jordan (eng): pasted snippet from auth-proxy logs: `2026-03-18T01:04:12Z svc=svc-ingest-prod req_id=abc123 method=POST path=/v1/auth token=svc_token=eyJhb...` repeated ~900 req/min from same src IP 198.51.100.27

lee (support): any 5xxs/customer errors reported? alerts show no user-facing 5xx, just auth endpoint spike.
samir (SRE): ok good on 5xxs. priority is contain + rotate svc account creds. ingress block for that IP/range first. ingest-ops, can you apply deny at edge?
ingest-ops: applied denylist 198.51.100.0/24 at edge layer (config pushed). :white_check_mark: monitoring for drop-off.
maya (sec): collecting evidence for forensics, saving matching request ids and timestamps. also searching for signs of exfil to external buckets.
jordan (eng): noticed logs show token present in request body and occasionally leaked to stdout in an older worker (ingest-worker-3) — likely debug log left enabled. snippet: `logger.info('auth token: %s', token)` — prepping patch to remove and rotate.

samir (SRE): that explains leak vector. immediate steps: 1) edge denylist (done), 2) rotate svc-ingest-prod keys, 3) scrub public logs / revoke any exposed artifacts, 4) notify legal if keys confirmed exfil. who's owning rotation?
jordan (eng): i'll start rotation now. will create new key, update k8s secret `svc-ingest-prod-creds`, rolling restart pods in rollout-stable namespace. ETA ~8m.
maya (sec): while jordan rotates, please snapshot the suspect container filesystem for postmortem. also run `aws s3api list-objects --bucket external-forwarders --prefix prod/` to confirm no uploads.
jordan (eng): snapshot created, secrets updated, restarting pods. command in case-it-helps: ``kubectl set image deploy/ingest --container=worker worker:sha-abc123 && kubectl rollout status deploy/ingest``

lee (support): prepping a customer-facing note template in #customer-notices. no customers impacted yet; we should be transparent if keys are confirmed leaked.
maya (sec): found one object in external bucket with timestamp matching spike — copying to secure forensics bucket and initiating takedown request. filing takedown with cloud provider now.
samir (SRE): good. please rotate any CI tokens that reference svc-ingest-prod, and scan CI logs for `svc_token=` occurrences. jordan, confirm downstream services have new creds.
jordan (eng): CI tokens scanned, no matches. downstream services updated and healthy. rolling restarts completed.
maya (sec): legal @legal-team should be looped if forensic shows external exfil. adding placeholder for evidence bundle.
pagerbot: ACTION_LOG — edge denylist applied; secrets rotation initiated by jordan; suspect object quarantined. oncall handoff scheduled in 30m to night-sre.
samir (SRE): summary: containment OK (denylist + rotation + takedown). next: full audit of debug logging, scrub public buckets, rotate any collateral keys, postmortem tomorrow. assigning owners and follow-ups in incident doc.

lee (support): noted. I'll draft comms and stand by for legal guidance.
maya (sec): will prepare timeline and IOCs, will attach to incident doc.
samir (SRE): thanks team. if anything spikes again re-open pager here. escalating to incident response for PII review. ending live bridge, moving to async follow-ups.
